convention.source_notation_note: The 2020 source labels |211> as n=2 and writes its hydrogenic denominator as n+l+1, while its Eq. (13) coefficient has the radial-index factorial form. The source prose also says it uses n for principal n. To avoid variable overloading, this manifest records N and n_r separately. The |211> identification and the n=l+1 nodeless family are explicitly shown in arXiv:1411.2263v3 Fig. 1; the 2020 Fig. 3 caption explicitly requires l=m=1..5. For Eq. (13), n_r is the factorial index and the denominator is N. For the Bose occupation n^4, use N, as specified in arXiv:2103.06812v2 Sec. 3.1 Eq. (13).
convention.mode_selection_basis: For each source-required l=m, select the lowest nodeless principal level N=l+1. The 2020 source identifies |211> as fastest for l=1 and calls l=m=1..5 dominant in Fig. 3; the source hydrogenic convention identifies the nodeless sequence.
